9178471.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Timer function that can be deactivated
- Perfect for any home or garden this festive season
- Suitable for indoor or outdoor use
- Multi-function options

## Information
This set is designed to add a festive touch to your home, with LEDs spaced approximately 2.5cm apart on a green wire, providing a dense and beautiful illumination. With a 5m lead length from the UK 3-pin transformer to the first bulb, these lights are easy to set up. The dual-purpose button on the transformer allows you to switch through 8 functions, including static, combination, waves, sequential, slow glow, chasing flash, slow fade, and twinkle flash. Additionally, a built-in memory chip retains your previous setting. These lights are suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, with an IP20-rated transformer that should be kept dry at all times. The non-replaceable LEDs are energy-efficient, making them an eco-friendly choice, and they can be used beyond Christmas for various occasions. The recommended LED count for your Christmas tree depends on its height, with higher counts recommended for taller trees.
